svg.aria-label: フランス領ポリネシアの島嶼群
svg.title: フランス領ポリネシアの島嶼群
svg.desc: 5つの島嶼群と景色の実座標を示す地図。左上はソシエテ諸島を同じ海岸線データで拡大した別枠。フランス本土は含まない。
svg.metadata: Target land: GSHHG/GSHHS full-resolution shoreline via Basemap 2.0.0 (Paul Wessel and Walter H. F. Smith; https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/wessel/gshhg/), assigned with Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 countries ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19 (public domain) unit PYF (French Polynesia); internal land boundaries follow Natural Earth. Surrounding land: the same GSHHG shoreline, drawn to the canvas edge. WGS84; local-equirectangular-fit-v1, 1200x760. Atoll lagoons are filled so each atoll reads at this scale. Society Islands inset: same geometry at uniform scale.
